newsitem.title: UK: Bradford & Bingley ups mortgage rate to 7.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bradford & Bingley ups mortgage rate to 7.35 pct.

text.p: Bradford and Bingley Building Society, one of the few remaining large mutually-owned societies, announced on Wednesday it had raised its standard variable mortgage rate by 0.36 percentage points to 7.35 percent following the UK rate hike last week.

Bradford and Bingley said the rise was among the lowest in the market after the Bank of England raised base rates by 0.25 percent. The society's mortgage rate compares with the 7.6-percent level charged by mortgage giants like Abbey National Plc.
The new Bradford and Bingley rate kicks in on May 18.
